tei:div.tei:p: (a)༄༅// kabiwāgaḥkāmadhenunāmabhabashāntaurguṇaushtsabalabhūtyagrahīṇamadhyamaissaṃgrahāṇāṃdeshayāssaṃwarṇaṇātārambhasyaprashnakāropāyānodāharaṃbidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// srid zhi'i yon tan dang stobs 'byor mchog dman bar pas bsdus pa'i yul rnams la bsngags pa las brtsams pa'i zhu yig stob pa'i dper brjod snyan dngags ngag gi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛtta mi 'gyur 'dod pa dang ldan pa shin tu skye 'gro la ngo mtshar rtogs byed pas rnam grangs brgyad stong chig brgya go gnyis mchis pa'i nang gsel gzhung gis dngos zin ma yin pa nyis stong dang lnga brgya dgu bcu rtsa lnga pa nas rnyed pa'i prāstās mdzes pa'o// ༄༅// buddhasarb+beṣāṃkulāgraḥkaulishaṃdharaḥkobidānandasyadzambudwīpanāṭakeḥkalpabhadrashrīghanorādzyaṃmahānamanypaṇḍitaḥkāryaist+rayāṇāñtsaprawart+taye// ༄༅// sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs mchog rdo rje 'chang*// 'dzam gling mkhas pa kun dga'i zlos gar gyis// bskal bzang dpal stug rgyal srid chen po la// mkhas tshul gsum gyi 'khor los sgyur la 'dud// phyogs bcu'i rnam 'dren kun gyi mkhyen pa'i dpal// smon lam byed pos cig car bskrun pa'i gzugs// sgrib bral ye shes me long 'jam dpal dbyangs// gang dang gnyis min dpal ldan bla mas skyongs// mnyen lcug sor mos bsnun pa'i rgyud mangs sgra// drug cu'i dbyangs dang lhan bsres srid zhi'i dngos// rgyan gsum snyan dngags glu len mtsho byung mas// ci 'dod legs bshad 'jo ba'i gnyer mdzod cig /yul gyi yon tan snyan dngags dam pa las// nyer 'phos bsngags pas thob pa dga' ba'i dpal// de 'dra srid pa 'di na rin che ba'i// zong gis bskal par bsgrubs kyang 'grub ma yin// daṇḍī'i gzhung lugs rin chen 'byung gnas che// blo gros ri bos bsrubs skyes 'phrin yig gi /dper brjod kun phan gzhon nus dpyod ldan gyi// yid dbang ku mud rab dga'i 'dzum dmul cig /de'ang 'dir srid zhi'i yon tan dang stobs 'byor mchog dman bar pas bsdus pa'i yul la bsngags pa las nye bar brtsams pa'i 'phrin yig stob pa'i tshul rnams cung zad dper brjod pa la/

thog mar bod yul 'dir yongs su grags pa'i dpal sa skya pa/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa/ paṇa chen sprul sku/ 'dren mchog karma pa lta bu che ba'i yon tan can la 'bul na/ ༈ swasti bi dza yantu/ stobs bcu'i dbang phyug nyi ma'i rtsa lag gis// legs gsungs chos kyi 'od snang yongs bzung nas// sa gsum 'gro blo'i 'dab stong 'dzum par dmul// smra dbang chos kyi snang byed zhabs padmor// zhes sam/ legs bris mi bdag gdengs can dbang sogs kyi// thor tshugs nor bus gang gi zhabs rdul dag /nyer bsten mkhyen brtse nus pa dpag yas bdag /bsnyengs bral gdong lngas bteg pa ga la bar// zhes sam/ dpag yas shes bya'i yul kun ye shes spyan// skye bar sbyangs pas dkyus su bsring byas nas// ji bzhin 'doms pa'i rgyal po'i zhabs zung dag /brtan byed rdo rjes mtshan pa ga la bar// zhes sam/ rnam 'dren bstan pa'i mkha' klong las// mkhas tshul gsum gyi char che bas// 'gro rgyud sa gzhir dge legs dbyar// 'gugs byed skyabs mchog zhabs stegs drung*// zhes pa lta bu dang*/ yang na/ dbang chos kyi bdud rtsi thob pa la 'og gi sa bcad gnyis pa'i nang nas gang 'os blos dpyad de yang blangs kyang btub ste/ de dag gang 'os kyi 'bebs zhabs su/ grangs med lus kyi sdong bu ldem pa'i phang*// sor bcu'i thal sbyar me tog mdangs 'tsher bas// nyer btud rnam gsum dad pa'i sbrang rtsir spyod// rab dga'i 'phur lding bsgyur ba'i dbyangs chung 'bul// zhes sam/ dri khyer dal bus lo 'dab bskyod pa'i khrod// khu byug bu mo rgyags pa'i glu len bzhin// sku drin yon tan dran pa'i shugs byung gi /phyogs re'i che bar bsngags pa'i dbyangs chung 'bul// zhes sam/ che ba'i yon tan yi ge'i rgyang klu yis// dad gus sems kyi rir skyes bu mo'i yid// dbang bral phyogs der lan gcig min drangs pa'i// slob 'khor gyur pa'i ngag nas 'di skad gsol// zhes sam/

kun phan mthong ba'i gnyis skyes bu// bzhin gyi 'dzum brgyar grol ba bzhin// zla bral thugs rje'i drin dran pa'i// shugs las nyer 'khrungs dbyangs 'di 'bul// zhes pa lta bu gang rung gi 'phro nas/ dpag yas bsod nams kun gsal 'gram dkyus su// mthong na mi mthun gyis dben gzugs sku'i nyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od brgyas bstan srid kyi// phan bde'i chu skyes 'dab stong cis mi bzhad// ces bka' tham gyi 'byor lan med na de tsam gyis chog mod/ 'byor lan yod pa lta bu yin na/ phan bde'i chu skyes 'dab stong bzhad ring nas// phyag rgya'i 'khor los bandu dzī wa kas// mkhur tshos mdzes pa'i glegs bu'i yid 'phrog gzugs// sngags mdud med pa'i tshe tsī na'i 'phrul dar sogs gang yin bsgyur/ sngags btab mdud pa'i len bu g.yo ldan gyi// ci 'dod snyan pa'i 'phrin snyan shod bzhin 'byor// zhes sam/ grangs med skye ba'i legs byas mdzub rtse yis// legs bris dge mtshan lham mer snang ba'i sku// nyer 'tshe'i yid srubs phyogs las rnam rgyal nas// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rgyan du brling ba'i tshe// 'chad rtsom brtsad pa'i phrin las snang ba yis// phyogs dang phyogs bral pha rol kun nyul nas// mda' lnga'i bdag pos bsti gnas phrogs so zhes// skyo bas rang lus thal bar sbyangs sam snyam// gang tshe mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sprin rum nas// nyams ldan tshig gi 'brug sgra stong ldir zhing*// gya nom skyes kyi gru char mi 'chad pas// yid kyi dbyig 'dzin rdzogs ldan dga' ston sbyor// zhes sam/ sngon sbyangs rtsal gyis bskyed pa'i mkhyen dbyings su// shes bya'i dngos kun dog pa med chud pa'i// ngo mtshar 'di ni sna tshogs las pa yi// 'phrul gyis lan brgyar bdal ba ma yin nam// gang tshe thugs rje'i chu gter bsrubs las skyes// bka' lung glegs bu'i zla tshes lha reg bkar// nyer mtshon gya nom skyes dang mnyam 'byor bar// kun dga' gsar pa'i sa mos 'dzum dkar bzhad// ces sam/

bsod nams kha ba'i rdul tshogs brtsegs pa'i spor// dge mtshan nyi zla'i 'od 'tsher dkris pa'i sku// skyabs kun 'dus pa'i byin rlabs nyal 'gro'i rgyun// lus can sgrib pa'i rims nad gzhil ba nas// srid zhi'i brjod bya mtha' dag rgyan gsum lam// nyer song bka' yi glegs bu'i mtshar sdug gzugs// sna tshogs skyes kyi do shal gyis bklubs te// rang rtags dmar pa'i mkhur tshos ngom bzhin 'byor// zhes sam/ phyogs bcu'i lus med thul kun gyi// mkhyen nus brtse ba'i rang bzhin gang*// mkhas btsun bzang por zlos pa'i gar// gdul bya'i blo ngor cir yang ston// thugs rje'i gdengs can pho brang las// legs skyes yi ge'i bsil sbyin mkhan// sna tshogs khud pa'i skra tshogs rtser// ngal stegs bgyid 'byor rjes su rang*// zhes pa lta bu gang 'os kyi mthar/ ljongs 'dir 'khod pa'i mos blo'i mdongs mtha' can// mkhyen brtse'i sprin gyi phang par mig gtod tshe// bar chad snyi thogs dregs pas ma zin par// 'tsho bde dge ba'i mtshar sdug ngom pa'i skabs// zhes sam/ skyabs gsum thugs rje'i ma la ya klung gis// dal rten nye zho'i sos dus tshad gdung dbal// ring du bcil ba gang tshe dge spyod kyi// 'jug ngogs lhag bsam gom pa bkod kyin mchi// zhes sam/ 'di na dal rten dbyar skyes rkang 'thung de// mthun min phyogs kyi dri bzhon ma gtses skabs// rnam 'dren bstan par sman 'dod yal 'dab dag /khor yug 'gengs pa'i lhag bsam mi bskyud tsam// zhes pa'i rjes su mtshams zhus kyi rigs yod na 'dir 'dri/ med na/ slad mar bsil ldan ljongs 'khod lus can gyi// gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i 'byung gnas gang*// gsang gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du// 'pho bral bskal pa'i srid du brtan pa dang*// bdag cag ltos bcas kyis mtshon sems can rnams// sgrib bral ye shes gzigs pa'i khongs de nas// nam yang bskyud pa med pa'i bka' lung gi

/legs bshad bdud rtsi snying la sim stsol mkhyen// zhes sam/ slad dus su yang rgyal bstan nyin mor byed// khams gsum 'gro ba'i gti mug mun bsal slad// mkhas pa'i spyod tshul shing rtas brtan bgyid cing*// shes bya kun gyi ltad mo snang byed 'tshal// chos las skyes pa'i bka' 'bangs thugs brtse yi// khor yug yangs par chud pa'i bka' stsal gyi// snyan dngags zil dngar thar pa'i gsos sman can// yan lag mchog rtser reg pa'i bka' drin mkhyen// zhes sam/ 'byung 'gyur da ltar bcas pa'i gdul bya la// snying brtse'i rjes su chags gzugs 'khor ba'i dngos// nam zhig mtha' can nyid du ma gyur bar// ri dbang lta bur brtan par 'tsho gzhes gsol// snying rjes 'dzums pa mi mnga'i 'dren byed zur// ltos bcas bdag 'gro'i rgyud du 'jug pa'i brdar// bka' stsal snyan dngags gsar pa spyi bo'i rgyan// nyer son skal ba mchog la sbyor cig mkhyen// zhes sam/ slad char rnam 'dren stobs bcu pa'i// lung rtogs chos kyi snang byed gang*// gzhom bral rdo rje'i khams brtan pa'i// dge mtshan 'od brgya 'bar ba nas// ye shes gzigs pas bdag rgyud la// khyab pa'i legs gsungs gdams pa'i bcud// thob pa'i skal bzang ci gnang ngam// zhes pa lta bu gang 'os re bris pa'i mthar/ zhu yig rten bcas 'bul ba po gang yin smos pa ni/ de skad gus pa'i yid mtsho las skyes pa'i/ zhu yig chu skyes phon por rten gang yin gyi rnam grangs mchan bur bris pas thus/ rten chung gi ge sar gzhon nu 'dzum phreng ngom pa 'di/ mos gus can gyi phreng rgyud mkhan mas phul/ zhes sam/ zhu yig ngang pa'i bu mos rten phran gyi// 'jam mnyen 'dab bsgyur rjod byed gdangs snyan can// spyan lam padma'i rdzing bu gang yin der// rtse gcig dad pa'i stegs las bskyod de song*// zhes sam/ de lta'i zhu gsol rkang drug bu// kun dga'i dbyangs snyan mgrin 'jo zhing*// rten gyi 'dab mnyen bsgyur brtson pas// dad blo'i me tog sbubs las thal// zhes pa lta bu'o//

༈ /gnyis pa rang gzhan la sdom pa gsum gyi bka' drin thob pa'i bla ma rdo rje slob dpon gyis gtsos pa'i mkhan slob mkhas grub kyi rigs la 'bul na'ang bka' tha ma dmar nag gi khyad par bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs phal cher gong ma de kho nas chog mod/ 'dir yang dper brjod kyi phreng ba cung zad 'god na/ rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i dpal// gdan gsum lha yi grong khyer rdzogs pa'i sku// gnas skabs mthar thug legs pa'i dpal 'jo ba// skyabs mchog bla ma'i zhabs stegs ga la bar// zhes sam/ theg gsum bstan pa'i snying po yongs bzung nas// tha dad sems can skal bzhin 'doms mdzad pas// nges legs lam nas 'dren pa'i thugs rje'i gter// gang gi zhabs stegs 'pho 'gyur dben pa'i drung*// zhes sam/ dus gsum bde gshegs kun gyi bgrod gcig lam// ma lus legs par 'doms pa'i phrin las kyis// srid pa snying po can du sgrub byed pa// lam mchog smra ba'i dbang phyug zhabs stegs drung*// zhes pa lta bu gang rung gi 'phro nas/ legs gsungs zil dngar thigs pas blo yi snod// skal ba mi dman gyur pa'i slob 'bangs des// mi phyed dad pa'i thal sbyar gtsug bkod de// sprul pa'i lus brgyas btud kyin 'di skad gsol// zhes sam/ tshad med thugs rje'i zla zhal dran pa'i mod// gus ldan yid dbang sa dga'i me tog kha// kun nas rangs pa'i 'dzum brgya grol ba las// mi 'gyur phreng bsgrigs ge sar 'di skad dgod// ces sam/ dad gsum lag pa zlos pa'i gar bsgyur bas// snyan dngags gzhung gi dbyar skyes nags khrod nas// nye bar btus pa'i tshig gi me tog dkar// mos gus stobs kyi snyim pas nyung zad 'thor// zhes pa gang rung gi 'phro nas/ yul gyi che ba brjod pa phal cher gong ltar byas kyang rung mod/ 'dir yang cung zad dper brjod na/ rnam 'dren kun gyi mkhyen nus thugs rje yi// sgyu 'phrul rnam rol mchog gi slob dpon tshul// skal bzang gdul bya rgyal ba kun lam nas// bde bar 'dren pa'i phrin las dar bab tshul// ris bral skye bo'i smra sgo'i tambu raḥ// ched du ma brdungs rang sgra 'byin pa 'dis// yid kyi khye'u chung kun dga' gsar pa'i gar// 'byung tshogs gzugs kyi phang par bsgyur bas brel// zhes sam/

gsung shog gi lan lta bu yod na/ gang tshe legs par bshad pa'i gling bu las// srid zhi'i blang dor ston pa'i rnar snyan dbyangs// 'gag med rten yig rten dmigs bsal dgos tshe rnam grangs mchan bu dgod/ gyi skyes bzang yid 'phrog ma'i// sor rtses zlos gar dang bcas 'byor pas spro// zhes bsgyur ba'am/ tshogs zung rgya mtsho'i snying po mtshan bzang nyi// yid srubs thul gyi lugs bzang mkha' dkyil du// mi zad dge legs rta ljang theg par brten// mkhas tshul dri med 'od stong 'gyed pa nas// thugs rje tshad las 'das pas ma bskyud brdar// 'di phyir sman 'dogs legs gsungs 'phrin shod ma// phun tshogs skyes kyi len bu g.yo ldan des// phyag rgya'i lang tsho ngom bcas 'byor drin che// zhes sam/ sbyangs stobs mi dman 'jam dpal mdzub rtse yis// legs phye gtam gyi sgo nas shes bya'i gzhung*// mtha' dag legs par bshad pa'i dbyangs 'jo bas// dpyod ldan brtan pa rang dbang 'phrog ring nas// don bzang rin chen phye ma tshar dngar ba'i// legs gsungs skal ba dang ldan shing rta'i rgyun// gnang skyes rlabs kyi phreng ba brgya g.yo ba// gus blo'i sa gzhir gtams pa'i bka' drin byung*// zhes pa lta bu gang 'os kyi mthar/ 'di na rnyed dka'i rten gyi za ma tog /legs par gsungs pa'i zil dngar zab rgya che// byang chub snying po'i bar du 'dzin 'dod blo// smra mchog phyogs su gdengs kha bstan pa'i skabs// zhes sam/ 'di na mos gus snyim pa yis// chos tshul legs bris btung ba'i mchog /thar pa'i srog 'tshor gzhib 'dod kyi// blo gros lha bu snga mkhor gnas// zhes sam/ sngar gyi khrod nas gang 'os btus kyang rung ste/ gang rung gi 'phro nas mtshams zhus kyi rigs yod na 'dir 'god/ med na/ slad kyi dus na mdo sngags chos kyi srog /'tsho byed smra ba mkhas pa'i sman pa mchog

/ris bral gdul bya'i dpyid du brtan bzhugs shing*// chos tshul bdud rtsi'i dga' ston 'gyed pa dang*// chos thob pa'i bla ma lta bu la/ legs gsungs zab yangs snying pos bskyed pa'i bu// 'di phyir phan par 'doms pa'i dbang phyug gis// rjes su 'dzin brdar phebs par 'os pa'i mchid// sgra 'dzin dri za'i rol mo'i spun zlar stsol// zhes sam/ slad du'ang gnas skabs mthar thug bsam don dpal// ci 'dod 'jo ba skyabs mchog dbang gi rgyal// mtha' yas gdul bya'i lhas bskos rgyal mtshan rtser// dge legs gzi brgya 'bar zhing brtan bzhugs gsol// tshad med thugs brtse'i zla snang dkar po yis// kho bo ltos bcas rgyud kyi sa mos tshal// 'bab stegs bcas pa'i snyan dngags tsa ko ra// rab dga'i zlos gar gyis rtsen bka' drin mkhyen// zhes sam/ slad du'ang gang sku kai la sha ri ltar// ches brling 'tsho gzhes bzhugs dang chab cig tu// brjod bya'i dngos kun snyan dngags lam song ba'i// legs bshad gaṅgā'i rgyun 'drar stsol ba

phal pa yin na stsol bar mkhyen/ zhes bsgyur/ zhu// zhes pa lta bu gang 'os kyi mthar/ de skad zhu ris khu byug dga' ma yis// rjod byed ngag tshig mgrin pa'i glu len gyin// lha reg gis mtshon rten gyi 'dab bsgyur nas// mi mtho ris rten gyi zhes bsgyur/ bdag rigs kyi sā la'i nags nas song*// zhes sam/ zhu yig zla shel dkar po'i ngos gzhi la// rjod byed tshogs pa gsum pa'i stong gzugs dag /lha dar gyis mtshon rten dang lhan cig nyid// rang phal pa yin na/ dad pa'i nor can bsti ba'i gnas nas phul/ zhes bsgyur/ sa skyong rigs kyis bsti ba'i gnas nas phul// zhes sam/ de skad 'phrin shod ka la piṅka'i byas// rten gyi spu sdug lus 'degs rab bskyod de// tshogs gsum mgrin pa snyan dgur bsgyur bzhin pas// shis pa'i bsti gnas stegs las yud kyis thal// zhes pa lta bu gang 'os 'dri'o// ༈ /gsum pa gnas lnga rig par mkhas pa'i rigs la/ thams cad mkhyen rgyu shes bya rig pa'i gzhung*// ji snyed mkhyen klong gcig cig dog pa med// chud pa'i ngo mtshar chu klung bye ba yis// ngom med dag byed gter gyi rjes 'gro'i drung*// zhes sam/ shes bya'i yul rnams sgrib pa'i lha min spun// mkhyen pa'i gsus khyim cher btul gtsug lag gzhung*// grangs med chu bo btung mthar legs bshad kyi// bdud rtsi skyugs pa'i smra mkhas drang srong cher// zhes pa gang rung gi 'bebs 'og nas/ 'dir 'khod mtho ris skye ba'i nags khrod nas// dal 'byor rten gyi mya ngan med pa'i kha// dad gus sgeg mo'i rkang rtses phye ba las// snyan dngags ge sar rtse dgas dgod la dgongs// phyi nang shes bya'i gzhung lugs mthong khyod kyis// dpyad pa gsum gyis brtsad pa'i g.yar lam du// rtogs dka'i khengs pas bsgyings pa'i zab rgya che'i// shes bya'i dngos 'ga' yod med 'phyang mo nyug

/gnas lnga rig pa'i gzhung don ma 'dres par// nyams dang 'gyur ba'i ro ldan rgyan gsum lam// nyer song dbyangs kyi rgyal mo dgyes pa'i glus// mang thos snying gi brtan pa brtse med phrogs// don gsal legs par mchid 'di mkhas khyod nyid// yang na lha yi bla ma 'dir lhags snyam// yid la som nyi'i yi ge cang 'dri ba// deng gi brjod bya 'doms pas khyod blor nges// 'dir 'khod bde bar rtsen 'di legs bris bu// dga' tshal rtse 'jor rol rjes rkang pa 'jog /tsha bas nyen la lho phyogs rlung gis bzhin// dkon mchog thugs rje'i nus pa gnas 'dir zhugs// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i srog zungs ring 'tshor byed// mkhas par 'os pa'i las byed sman pa khyod// yid srubs dpung las rnam par rgyal ba'i thabs// shis pa'i cho ga sgrub la mi lhod 'tshal// 'byor lan dgos pa'i tshe/ mtsho ldan mgrin par chags pa'i legs bshad kyi// rgyud mangs bsnun pa'i glu las gnas skabs dang*// mthar thug don gyi 'phrin snyan ci dang ci// shod byed gsung gi glegs bu stsol yang zhu// de skad dpal ldan daṇḍi'i gzhung lugs pas// 'brug lo lta bu la/ gnam lo dbyar rnga gsar pa'i zhag gi mdzod// rgyu skar hor zla brgyad pa lta bu la/ khrums nyi'i dkar phyogs tshes gsum lta bu la/ rgyal ba'i nyin// dge mtshan rnam bkra'i ljongs nas phyogs der song*// zhes pa lta bu'o// ༈ /bzhi pa mtshan nyid phyogs kyi rab 'byams pa lta bu la/ rab 'byams gzhung lugs thos pa'i mig stong gsal// lung rigs 'gal 'brel dpyod pa'i rtse brgya pas// log rtogs ri bo'i rgyun lugs yongs gcod pa'i// sde snod bstan la smra ba'i dbang phyug drung*// zhes sam/ tshad mar gyur pa'i lung dang dngos po'i stobs// rigs pa'i rtsod ngag bye bas pha rol gyi// rgol ba'i gzhung ngan ming gi lhag byed pa// tshar gcod rig pa smra ba'i dbang phyug drung*// zhes pa gang rung gi 'og tu bcag 'bebs gang bab kyi 'phro nas// shes byar sbyangs pa'i blo gros mthu dman yang*// mkhas pa'i yon tan dran pa'i snyan dngags 'bul// mkhas pa'i mdun sar mkhas pa'i las 'os kyi// blun rmongs khrod du rig pas ci bgyir yod// nyi ma'i gnyen gyis legs gsungs chos 'dul gyi// bslab gzhi'i brtul zhugs kyis mdzes gzugs kyi sku// rin chen gser gyi lhun por thun mtshams kyi// dmar mdangs gsar pas dkris pa bzhin du brjid// bye mdo dbu sems gzhung gi gzhu sran dag

/rnam dpyod rgyud kyis rang dbang bkug pa las// nye bar 'phos pa'i lung rigs tshad ma'i mdas// log par smra ba'i snying 'bigs khyod rmad byung*// gang tshe legs par bshad pa'i cha rer yang*// nyams 'gyur 'bum gyi ro ldan daṇḍī pa'i// gzhung don las 'phos gsung dang chab cig nyid// skyes bzang phyag rgya'i 'khor los mtshan pa 'byor// zhes pa'i mthar rang phyogs kyi gleng ba man chad gong 'og nas ji ltar 'tshams pa blang ngo*// ༈ /lnga pa chos kyi bdud rtsi nod pa min pa'i bla ma'am dge ba'i bshes lta bu la 'bul na/ chos don legs par 'doms la mkhas gyur cing*// chos 'dul bslab gzhi bcas don bsrung la btsun// mkha' mnyam sems can don sgrub lhag bsam bzang*// mkha' ltar yangs ldan dge ba'i bshes drung du// zhes sam/ chos don legs par 'doms pa'i bshes gnyen las// chos tshul sdom pa nod pa'i skal ba can// chos don bsam dang bsgom pa lhur len pas// chos spyod dge bcur spyod pa de drung du// zhes pa lta bu gang rigs kyi 'og tu bcag 'bebs kyi 'phro nas/ rnam 'dren bstan pa'i 'dab stong rdzing bu'i nang*// dad dang kun dga'i 'phur lding gis rtsen pa'i// dal 'byor rten ldan ngang pa'i ded dpon des// rjod byed mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'di skad brdung*// zhes sam/ mi rang phal pa yin na/ srid pa'i gnas 'dir skyes pa'i nags khrod nas// zhes bsgyur/ dman sa bdag rigs kyi nags khrod nas// dar bab lang tsho'i puṇḍa rāe ka ni// dkon mchog byin rlabs nyi gzhon bcud 'thungs pas// bde dga'i yal 'dab rgyas pas 'di skad mchid// ces pa lta bu'i 'phro nas/ sngon dge'i shing rtas nyer drangs mtho ris rten// bstan pa'i snying po sdom gsum ci 'dod dbyig /ma tshang med pas yongs 'byor rang gzhan gyi// thar pa'i gsos su bsten par 'tsho las che// zhes sam/ 'byor lan med na de tsam gyis thus la/

'byor lan yod tshe/ thar pa'i gsos su 'gyed pa'i tshul la rangs// gang tshe ming tshig yi ge'i glu len mas// skabs bab mchid kyi gling bu bsgyur ba'i gdangs// snyan dgu'i lam nas shod pa'i mchu snyung de// rten gyi rgyan gos bklubs te 'byor drin bsams// zhes sam/ rnam dkar dge bas legs bskrun mtho ris gru// chos smra'i ded dpon chen pos bzung ba'i mthus// thub dbang chos kyi rin chen gling mchog phyin// gtan khrims nor bu'i bgo skal cang thob pa// gang tshe brjod bya'i snying po tshogs gsum gyi// rgyud nas 'phos pa'i gsung mchid lha gos kyis// nyer mtshon rten gyi khur bu thogs pa de// 'dren byed yul mngon bgyis tshe spro ba brtas// zhes pa lta bu'i rigs bsgres te shes par byas mthar/ rang gi gnas tshul gyi gleng ba ni/ 'dir 'khod 'byung lnga'i rtswa mchog ku sha'i tshogs// nye bar brtsigs pa'i dal rten spyil bu'i nang*// skyabs kyi dam pa dkon mchog dad gsum gyi// dkyil ka 'khyog min tsam zhig tshugs pa'i skabs// zhes sam/ 'di gar nang shes rkang drug gzhon nu mas// 'byung 'dus lus kyi chu skyes dam 'khyud tshe// shes bya'i yul dpyod ge sar dgod pa'i phang*// kun dga' gsar pa'i dbyangs snyan ma bskyud skabs// zhes pa gang rigs kyi mthar/ mtshams kyi gleng ba dang*/ yi ge rten bcas bskur ba'i yul gyi nges pa rnams gong ma ltar shes par bya'o// ༈ /drug pa bsod nams dbang stobs dang ldan pa'i sa skyong chen po'i rigs la 'bul na/ gtsug lag gzhung lugs dpyod pa'i stong phrag mig /gzhar yang dge ba'i phyogs la 'dzum min pa'i// chos ldan sa spyod grags pa'i mu khyud kyi// zhabs stegs mi dman sa srungs dbang po'i drung*// zhes sam/ dpag yas chab srid yangs pa'i 'od srungs byin// rlabs chen bsod nams gom stabs gcig cig gis// yongs gzhal phyogs las rnam rgyal sred med bu'i// zhabs stegs rin chen las grub ga la bar// zhes sam/

las shugs gser gyi 'khor lo sngon 'gro bas// chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor rang dbang du// bgyid la mi srun co 'dris rnam dben pa'i// sa skyong zhabs zung brtan byed khri drung du// zhes pa lta bu gang 'os kyi 'bebs 'og tu// rnam dkar legs mdzad kun phan dkyil 'khor che// mthong thos 'phral la bdag sems bram ze'i bu// rab dga' khong rgyas rus pa'i ke sa ras// 'dzum zer dkar pos mdun bsu 'di skad gsol// zhes sam/ sa rang phal ba yin na/ srid par skye ba'i rkang 'thung rgyas pa'i phang*// zhes bsgyur shes par bya'o// spyod rigs kyi rkang 'thung rgyas pa'i phang*// nang shes gtsug phud ldan pa kun dga'i mig /chos ldan spyod pa'i sprin rum la gtod cing*// mtsho byung dgyes pa'i tshig gi gdangs snyan bsgyur// zhes sam/ mdo khams dbyig 'dzin thig ler yid skyes kyi// rigs su skye bar zlos pas lha khyod kyi// rnam thar phyogs kyi bu mo'i sgra 'dzin bcud// sim don dga' dang gus pas 'di skad gsol// zhes rang phyogs kyi khengs pa bskyung ba'i ngag gang rigs kyi 'phro nas/ skye ba'i phreng bsags lhas bskos gdengs can grong*// smon lam dri gzhon gyis bsrubs srid pa 'dir// rgyal bstan legs bris grong khyer blar 'degs pa'i// snying stobs lhun po'i phrag pa ches brling gang*// 'jig rten mes po 'gugs pa'i las ma brtsams// rdzogs ldan sa spyod rtsod dus dga' ston ched// mgron du gnyer ma byas pa lha khyod ni// 'gro 'di'i bsod nams skal bar thob pas 'tsheng*// 'byor lan yod tshe/ gang tshe bka' lung glegs bu'i bdud rtsi'i zer// phyag rgya'i thun mtshams lang tshos 'khyud pa can// gya nom skyes bcas legs son dga' ba'i dpal// gzugs can zhig na srid pas ga la theg /ces sam/ mi dman bsod nams gdengs can spyi bo las// nyer 'phos sa spyod gzugs sku'i yid bzhin nor// chab 'bangs lhab lhub rgyal mtshan rtser 'god tshe// srid zhi'i rgud pa mtha' dag cis mi bcom// ci 'dod 'phrin shod bka' lung mdza' na mos// phyag rgya dar bab lang tsho'i mkhur chos ngom// gya nom gnang skyes len bu g.yo ldan de// bsod nams yangs pa'i khab tu khugs pas 'tsheng*// zhes sam/

skal bzang 'chi ba med pa'i mgon po de// 'gro 'di'i legs byas g.yab mos lan cig min// kun gyi rten gnas gyur pa'i sa skyong tshul// 'di na mgron du gnyer byas som nyi ci// ngang rgyud mnyen ldan pa tras dam 'khyud pa'i// lugs brgya dpyod pa'i nor bu'i phra tshom can// grags pa'i gser 'od ring 'phro'i kuṇḍa lam// phyogs bral lus phra'i mkhur chos rnam par spud// yi ge tshur 'byor ba'i lan gyi tshe/ gang tshe brjod bya'i snying po'i khur 'dren pa'i// bka' lung snyan dngags dam pa'i ngos rtse nas// phyag rgya'i re khās dgod pa gsar phebs pa'i// kun dga'i pha rol nam mkhas mtshon nus sam// zhes pa lta bu'i 'phro nas mtshams zhus kyi rigs yod na tshigs bcad lhug gang rung gi lam nas legs par bsdebs te 'dri'o// med pa'i tshe/ slad char rgyal ba'i myu gu'i skye ba nyid// bskal par brtan byed rig sngags mchog grub cing*// mar gyur yid can bde ba de rgyur bcas// 'god pa'i phrin las 'khor lo ring 'gror shog /byams brtse'i dkyil 'khor yangs par chab 'bangs tshogs// chos mthun spyod par gzhar yang ngal gso zhing*// mtsho ldan mgrin las 'phos pa'i legs bshad glu// snyan 'jebs mnyes gshin lam nas stsol cig gu// zhes sam/ slad du'ang ma brdal yangs pa'i dbyig 'dzin ltor// 'dris min kun la mdza' gcugs mchog gi sku// ma bteg kun gyi bla na 'tsho gzhes kyi// cho ga mi mchog sras bcas sgrubs shig gu// 'byor lan zhu dgos tshe/ sngon dge'i lam nas mdza' gcugs yid 'ong gis// mchid bu'i lag sbrel rjes dgongs thugs rje las// nyer 'khrungs 'phral yun dge ba'i bka' lung 'gas// re ba'i yol go 'gengs pa ci nas 'tshal// zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang bab dpyad mthar/ de skad snyan dbang gsol ba'i mi 'gyur phreng*// tsī na'i yul bskrun lha dar dkar pos mtshon// rten phran khur bu thogs nas bho ṭa'i ljongs// sa yi thig le zhig nas thal lo kye// zhes sam/

brjod bya padma'i bcud kyis cher myos pa'i// zhu ris rkang pa drug ldan rten chung gi /'dab mnyen cig dgar bsgyur te ljongs dam pa'i// chu skyes bzhad pa'i tshal nas bskyod thal lo// zhes sam/ gong du smos pa rnams nas bkrabs kyang thus pa nyid do// ༈ /bdun pa de las go sa dman pa'i mi dpon nam bka'i 'phrul blon dpyod ldan rang gi gnyen zlar gyur pa lta bu'i che brjod cung zad dgos pa'i rigs la 'bul na/ bstan jus blang dor dpyod pa'i gom rlabs kyis// gna' bo'i lugs srol dbyig 'dzin yongs gzhal la// snying stobs mi dman khur chen 'degs bzod pa'i// gzur gnas dpyod ldan sa srungs dbang po'i drung*// zhes sam/ sngon rabs lugs srol ma nor rig byed dag /phyogs lhung spyod pa'i chu gter klong bying ba// rnam dpyod gser mig rtsal gyis gdon bzod pa'i// sa 'dzin 'phrul blon zhes bsgyur/ phyugs bdag 'jug pa de drung du// zhes sam/ lugs brgya dpyod pa'i blo gros mig thur gyis// blang dor 'khrul rtog rab rib sgrib bsal nas// gna' bo'i lugs srol ltad mo yongs ngom pa'i// khrims gnyis kha lo sgyur dbang de drung du// zhes pa gang rung 'bebs che chung gang babs kyi 'phro nas/ chu 'dzin lang ling 'khrigs pa dal 'gros kyi// phyogs su rtse gcig mig gtod rma bya mos// lus 'degs spu sdug sna tshogs ngom byed kyin// gtsug mdzes mgo 'phang gtod pas 'di skad smra// zhes sam/ mi phyed mdza' gcugs dam pas sbrel legs pa'i// rgyud nas 'phos pa'i mngon 'dod brjod bya'i ros// kun nas myos pa'i snyan dngags dam pa'i 'phrin// tshar du dngar bas 'di skad ched du mol// zhes pa gang rung gi 'phro nas/ rnam dkar dge bas bskyed pa'i dal 'byor rten// gtsug lag zung gi khur chen 'degs pa la// nye zho'i rigs kyis ma gtses bder 'tsho zhing*// dge bcu'i spyod khrims ma bskyud rtun las che// yi ge tshur 'byor lan gyi tshe/

de tshe mdza' gcugs sems kyi rig byed pas// lhag bsam dkar 'jam gzhi mar ci dang ci'i// gleng ba dam pa'i 'phrin yig rten dang bcas// lta byed yul du lhags par rjes yi rang*// zhes sam/ deng dus mtho ris rten gyi rdzing bu'i nang*// rnam dpyod ches sgrin ngang pa'i rgyal po yis// bstan jus dge ba'i legs 'doms rdza rnga'i sgras// blo ldan sgra 'dzin snyan pa'i glur 'jo ba// gang tshe tshogs gsum ldan pa'i glegs bu la// rang rtags re khās sgeg pa rten dang bcas// nyes med son pa'i drin mtha' rtogs ched du// yid dbang skad cig du ma'i rnam par sprul// zhes sam/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das don sgrub pa'i rten// mtho ris yon tan 'ga' la dbang 'byor tshe// chab 'bangs bde rgyur bsgrub pa'i bsam sbyor gyis// sbyin bzhi'i spyod pa lhur len brtson ring nas// dri za'i bu mo'i glu dbyangs tambu ra'i// sgra dang mnyam par bsres las 'phos 'dra yi// brjod bya thams cad snyan dngags dam pa'i lam// legs par song ba'i 'phrin yig rten bcas 'byor// zhes pa gang rung gi 'phro nas/ ljongs kyi thig le 'dir 'khod kho bo cag /dal 'byor lus kyi lha bu gzhon nu de// gnas skabs bde ba'i zil dngar bsten pa la// phrag dog lha min skyabs gsum byin rlabs gzir// ma bzod lhun po'i 'og tu bros snyam byed// ces sam/ 'di na sa spyod

phal ba yin na/ 'di na dal ba brgyad ldan ba ku la// zhes bsgyur/ rigs kyi ba ku la// dkon mchog thugs rje'i yid 'phrog 'gram chang gis// rang gzhan 'byor bcu'i 'dab ma phye ba'i nang*// dge spyod bung ba rgyags pa'i glu len skabs// zhes pas mtshon te/ rigs bsgre shes par byas la mthar/ de skad mchid bu gleng ba'i bya ma rtas// rten phran ral pa'i zur phud g.yo ldan bcas// zhag 1 gi phung po'i gral tshes 13 dge ba'i nyin// don kun grub pa'i bsti gnas tshe nas so// zhes sam/ dpyid dus gzhan gsos dregs pa'i rgyang glu la// thos 'dzin ldan pas mnyan gyi 'on pas min// tshogs gsum smras pa'i don gang dpyod ldan gyis// mnyan par 'os kyi mong rtul ci byar yod// ces pa lta bus mtshon de rgya cher spel shes par bya'o// ༈ /brgyad pa rig pa'i gtsug lag 'dzin pa'i rigs las lha bzo mkhas pa lta bu la/ skye dgu'i bsod nams yul gyur rnam par 'dren// de sras zhi khro'i snang brnyan ji snyed dag /bkod legs ri mo'i lam nas ngom pa la// bsnyengs bral sna tshogs las pa'i rjes 'gro'i drung*// mi dman rigs su skyes de'i smra sgo las// skabs bab mol du bgro bya'i snying po rnams// rgyan gsum khong nas 'phos pa'i mi 'gyur phreng*// shog bu'i zla zhal bkrag tu cher bkod pa// skyes sbyangs mi dman tshigs bzang bzo bo yis// legs sbyangs blo gros mi sbyin skyes nyid las// gtsug lag dang po'i lugs bzang snang ba yis// ngo mtshar gzugs brgya'i ltad mo ci yang ngom// shes bya gang la sgrin rnams rigs stobs 'byor// cher rlom snying gi brtan pa 'gugs bgyid cing*// blo ldan mkhas pa'i go sar dbang 'byor ba// thams cad mkhyen rgyu gang la sbyangs pa'i mthu// bris 'bur gyi sku tshur 'byor ba'i lan lta bu la/ deng dus sgyu 'phrul sor mo zlos pa'i gar// ci yang bsgyur las snang srid chos ma lus// lta bas ngoms pa min pa'i mi mchog sku// bskrun legs sug rtser son drin lhag par che// zhes pa lta bu'i 'phro nas skabs kyi gleng ba gang 'os rnams bsring bar bya'o//

༈ /dgu pa drung yig mkhas pa lta bu la/ shes bya'i dngos rnams ming gzhi sngon rjes 'jug /bya byed las dang dus gsum rnam par dbye'i// lam nas 'phos pa'i legs bshad mgrin 'jo ba// thu mi'i lugs srol 'dzin pa de drung du// zla ba zhun mar co 'dri'i ngos gzhi la// mdzub rtse glog gi rtse dga' lta bu yis// mngon par bkod pa'i 'phrin yig gling bu ltar// lhang lhang 'jebs pa'i mchid bu 'di skad gleng*// sngon dges bskrun pa'i mtho ris rten gyi grus// bslab sbyangs brtson pa'i chu chen legs brgal nas// dpyod ldan go 'phang mi dman go sa der// bder gnas mkhas pa'i tshul la brtun las che// zhes pa'i 'phro nas gang 'os rigs 'gre'o// ༈ /bcu pa 'tsho byed mkhas pa'i rigs lta bu la// rnam shes dad pa'i bsti gnas 'gro lus rdzing*// 'byung khams ma snyoms 'khrugs pa'i rnyog pa dag /sman dpyad zas spyod ston pa'i ke ta kas// legs bgrungs tshe yi rig byed 'chang gi drung*// shis pa'i dpal kun 'jo ba'i yul gyi grur// las kyi byed pos nyer bskos bdag po des// bar skabs mchid du bgro bar 'os pa'i 'phrin// 'gyur med 'dus pa'i brda yis 'di skad mol// 'tsho byed rig pa'i gzhung gi nyal 'gro'i rgyun// thos bsam hub tu song ba'i smra sgo nas// gsos sman bdud rtsi yan lag brgyad pa'i klung*// 'dzad med skyugs pi blo ldan a gast+yaḥ /rjes 'dzin rig par mkhas pa'i 'ching zhags kyis// lus can srog gi dri za'i yid 'phrog ma// bro 'tshal lnga pa'i bya lam bgrod nye ba'ang*// rang dbang 'ching ba'i bzod ldan khyod 'dra su// zhes pa lta bu'o// ༈ /bcu gcig pa rtsis kyi rig pa smra ba'i rigs la/ dang po sangs rgyas rgyud dang gtsug na zla'i// gzhung lugs legs bzung klog gyur shes bya'i dngos// ji snyed bsgyur bkod ri mo'i lam nyid nas// ma nor 'doms pa'i dbang phyug gang de'i drung*// thams cad mkhyen rgyu gtsug lag 'chang khyod la// mngon dga'i mchu sgros phye ba'i khong sing nas// snyan dngags gzhung lugs sbrang rtsis myos las skyes// rjod byed rwa yig gnyis pa'i dbyangs 'di 'byin// rnyog bral blo gros ma dros grong khyer las// blang dor 'khrul pa'i dri ma 'khrud byed pa'i// skar nag rtsis rig ngag byed rgyun mang gis// sngon med phan bde'i dbyar skyes gzhon nu 'gugs// zhes pa lta bu'i 'phro nas mtshams kyi gleng ba sogs gang 'os dang sbrel lo// de dag thams cad la rang phyogs gnas tshul gyi gleng ba sogs nyung zad brjod na/

ljongs kyi thig le'i bsti gnas 'khod pa bdag /las bzang snying gi mdza' nas byin pa'i rten// bar med rgyal ba'i thugs rjes bsrungs pa'i khongs// nyer 'tshes gom pa 'god skabs gang du mchis// slad du rtsom pa thams cad sems can khams// phan 'dod sems kyi dam pa bskyed shes na// ci byas byang chub dam pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// dal rten snying po stongs min snying la chongs// dkar dkar shog bu'i shel dkar dwangs pa'i ngos// gsal gsal yi ge tshar du dngar ba'i sgras// lhang lhang sgra don rgyan gyi gdangs 'byin cing*// brel brel gom stabs ldan pa'i khur gyis khyer// zhes pa lta bur rigs 'gre sbyar ro// ༈ /bcu gnyis pa dkor gyi gnyer byed pa'am srid pa'i 'byor ldan gyi rigs la/ sngon rabs gtong phod mi dman dpung pa yi// yal ga re ba med pa'i phyogs brkyangs pas// skye 'dir mi zad dbyig la dbang 'byor ba// legs byas skal ba sbom po gang yin der// ljongs kyi thig le 'di nas brjod bya nyid// tshogs gsum gzugs su bkra ba'i snyan dngags dbyangs// rnam par dpyod ldan rnams kyi rna ba'i dpyid// gang las 'phos pa'i 'phrin du 'di skad mchid// chos srid zung gi gzhal bya'i dngos ma lus// phyogs su ma lhung rig pa'i srang mda' yis// legs bcal gtong dang len pa'i brgya phrag sgo// 'byed pas rang gzhan re ba 'gengs ring nas// 'byor lan dgos tshe gong ma rnams las gang 'os blangs la rigs 'gre'o// ༈ /bcu gsum pa skyes bu rtsal ldan gyi rigs la/ dar bab lang tsho'i dpal dang 'phong skyen sogs// sgyu rtsal rig par 'byangs pa'i ngo mtshar gyis// na zla'i skyes bu'i khengs pa snyol byed pa// dpa' rtsal rmad byung stag shar gang yin der// ched du bsring ba dpyod ldan skyes bu khyod// dga' byed lha bu'i skye ba ma blangs shing*// mda' lnga'i bdag po'i mig 'phrul byas min par// chen po la 'os lus ngag yid kyi rtsal// ji snyed yul la ches sgrin tshul la rang*// 'dir 'khod 'byung tshogs rten gyi gru gzings che// nang rigs ded dpon mkhas pas dbang sgyur tshe// bstan

phal pa yin na/ sna tshogs brel ba'i chu gter zhes bsgyur/ jus brel ba'i chu gter las bsgral nas// bde dga'i rin chen gter la rol ba'i skabs// mtshams kyi gleng ba sogs skabs su gang 'tshams bri'o// ༈ /bcu bzhi pa shin tu mdza' ba'i snying grogs lta bu la/ bzod sogs bsod nams shar ri'i phrag gong nas// legs par shar ba'i mtshar sdug zla ba'i bzhin// mngon mthong yid kyi ku mud gsar pa'i 'dzum// brgya phrag 'grol bar byed pa'i mdza' na bor// zhes sam/ mngon mthong bden min gtam gyis 'drid mi byed// snying gros tshul du mang po mi smra yang*// mkhris su bsnyen tsam yid dga'i dpal ster bar// snying grogs zla ba gzhon nu lta bu'i drung*// zhes pa lta bu'i 'phro nas/ blo gros phreng rgyud mkhan ma'i mdzub rtse yis// mgyogs par btus pa'i tshig sbyor me tog tshogs// mdza' gcugs sems kyi skud par bstar ba'i phreng*// kun dga'i dpal bskyed mdza' na'i mgrin par mdzes// zhes sam/ bde 'byor sā la'i rkang 'thung 'khrigs pa las// kun dga' khong nas rgyas pa'i dri mchog rta// mdza' bas sbrel ba'i tshong phrug gnas yul gyis// bskal pa'i gdung ba dbugs 'byin 'di skad mol// zhes pa lta bu gang rung 'phro nas/ deng dus las bzang yid 'phrog g.yab mo yis// 'khor ba'i khang par mgron du gnyer byas shing*// sngon las mes pos bgo skal 'dod pa lngar// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i lus 'tsho bde las che// 'di na lhag bsam spu sdug rma bya'i mig /dkon mchog thugs rje'i nam mkha'i gling gtod kyin// dar bab lang tsho'i do ra rgyas pa'i nang*// rang gzhan bde 'dod zlos bu'i gar gyis rtsen// mtshams kyi gleng ba yod na 'dir 'dri/ slad char yar ngo'i zla ba zhag re zhing*// cha shas 'phel phyogs rdzogs 'dis dar bab dag /mngon mthor bgrod la yig klog 'dri rtsis sogs// sgyu rtsal rig par sbyang dgos ston par mtshon// de skad

de skad rab dga' rgyas pa'i rkang 'thung las// zhes bsgyur/ sde bzhi rgyas pa'i rkang 'thung las// 'phrin snyan shod byed yal ga'i ri dwags des// rten phran ljon pa'i 'bras bu'i khur thogs nas// mdza' gcugs phyogs kyi yal gar 'khril te song*// zhes pa lta bu'o// ༈ /bco lnga pa mdza' mo mdzes shing mtshan bzang ba lta bu la/ legs bris lus phra'i skye ba blangs pa med// yid srubs sprul pa'i 'dod yon yang min pa'i// mngon 'dod ldan pa'i snying gi brtan pa dag /dbang med dbrog pa'i zla bzhin ma de'i drung*// zhes sam/ ched du ma bcos lus mdzes skye mched gtsang*// sdang min bzhin gyis zla gzhon mdzes par 'phrog /ma bgos kha nas li shi'i bsung 'thul ba'i// kun dga' bskyed pa'i snying gi mdza' na'i drung*// zhes sam/ zla ba'i bzhin la bung ba'i mig zung g.yo// utpal dmar po'i 'dzum sgros mu tig tshems// dbang sngon mgo skyes glog gi rna cha can// 'dod ldan yid dbang 'phrog pa'i mdza' na mor// zhes pa rnams las gang rung gi 'phro nas/ ston zla zhun mar co 'dri'i shog bu'i gzhir// dar bab lang tsho las byung mdza' ba'i 'phrin// rnam gsal yi ge'i gad mo 'byin 'dra 'di// lta byed yul gyi bdud rtsi bzhin du 'thungs// zhes sam/ mdza' ba las skyes blo yi smyu gu'i rtses// rab dga' rgyas pa'i rtse 'jo'i zlos pa'i gar// yid 'ong dkar 'jam shog bu'i do ra'i nang*// bsgyur ba'i ltad mo 'di la mig dbang gtod// ces sam/ mtshar sdug gzugs kyi re khā kun rtog gi /pir rtses yid kyi rtsig ngos 'dri bzhin du// dga' ba'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i glu chung dag /dal gyis len 'dir rna dbang gtod cig gu// zhes pa rnams las gang rung gi 'phro nas/ deng dus 'dren byed dpyid 'di padma dkar// phra ldem sdong bu'i rtse na g.yo ba'am// lus phra khyod lus 'jo sgeg g.yo ba'i bzhin// 'dzum dkar ngom pa ci yin 'phyang mo nyug

/ces sam/ deng dus mchog min skye ba'i shar ri'i rtser// mngon par 'phags pa'i dge mtshan ri bong gzugs// rnam bkra'i dar bab lang tsho'i zla gzhon gyis// kun yid dbrog pa'i 'dzum zer ring du spro// zhes sam/ dkar bsil btung na tshim pa med pa'i bde// ster byed lang tsho ldan pas 'jug pa'i yul// sna tshogs 'dab stong bzhad pa'i khrus kyi rdzing*// 'o ma'i rang bzhin can 'di snying du sdug /ces pa lta bu gang rung gi 'phro nas/ rab dga' bskyed pa so yi ze'u 'bru dag /rab dkar 'dzum pa'i sing nas mdza' gcugs gtam// rab snyan sbrang rtsir spyod pa'i glu 'dra ba// rab dkar rten gyi 'dab ma bsgyur te son// gang tshe lta byed yul du sngon med kyi// ltad mo yid 'ong mthong bas ma tshim par// 'dod lhas rnam sprul srid pa'i dpal kun la// chags bral dam pa'i brtul zhugs blangs sam snyam// zhes sam/ gang tshe 'phrin yig snyan 'jebs glu yi rgya// ma nyams son pas blo ldan dga' ba brtas// dpyid dus khu byug rgyags pa'i dbyangs dang po// kun gyi sgra 'dzin dpal du len min nam// zhes sam/ de tshe mdza' gcugs mchid kyi pho nya mos// lus 'tsho byed pa ro brgya'i bcud len bza' btung gi rigs 'byor len gyi tshe/ bcas// chab cig lhags par rab dga' rgyas pa'i sems// sngon med zlos pa'i gar gyis brel lam snyam// zhes pa lta bu gang rung 'phror rang phyogs gnas tshul smos pa/ ljongs kyi dam pa 'dir 'khod rgyal rigs rang dge slong yin na/ shākya'i sras zhes bsgyur/ skyes// bslu med skyabs gsum thugs rje'i gdung skyob dkar// khams gsum srid pa'i bla mar 'khor ba'i grib// skyabs su 'gro ba'i bzlas brjod ma bskyud skabs// zhes sam/ srid pa 'dir yang dal rten ring 'tsho mkhan// tshe sbyin sgeg mo'i mchog sbyin mdzub rtse nas// 'chi med tshe yi zil dngar 'dzag pa'i rgyun// dang 'dod snyim pas 'thungs bzhin bde ba'i skabs// zhes pa lta bu gang rung gi 'phror/

srid zhi'i phun tshogs sgrub rten dbyar skyes shing*// lang tsho'i yal ga brtas rtser chags pa yi// mdza' gcugs lam nas gleng ba'i me tog dkar// snyan 'jebs rna ba'i rgyan du bsring yang 'tshal// de rigs la rtse mtshar gyi gtam lta bu byed na/ dar bab lang tsho'i rtse dga' rjes dran pas// 'thibs bur yur ba sad pa'i 'dren byed kyi// yul du mngon gyur srid pa'i dpal kun la// dgyes dgur rtsen pa'i skal bzang nam zhig myang*// zhes sam/ slad kyi char yang yid srubs kyis sprul pa'i// lus 'di thar par 'dod pa'i blos dben na// skye ba don gyis stongs pa'i tshul shes nas// dad dang dge ba'i snying po can du mdzod// mdza' gcugs yid dga'i yid las 'phos pa'i gtam// sna tshogs gleng gzhi gleng ba'i mchu snyung mas// tshogs gsum rgyud mangs rgyud las 'phos pa'i dbyangs// rna bar snyan pa'i snyan dngags phreng ba stsol// zhes pa gang rung gi 'phror/ dkar 'jam shog bu'i me long dngas pa na// na tshod dar bab las byung brjod bya gsal// gsal byed yi ge tshar du dngar byas 'di// 'di phyogs bde bar 'tsho tshul bsnyad du thal// zhes pa lta bu ste/ 'dis mtshon te rgya cher spros shes par bya ba las thams cad 'drir mi ldang ba nyid do// de las 'phros nas dman 'bring gi yul de dag las chos kyi bag chags bzang po yod pa'i rigs la chos dang mthun pa'i gtam gyis dga' bar bskyed pa'am khe 'byor grags pa sogs tshe 'di kho na'i don las/ phyi ma 'byung 'gyur gyi don du dge sdig las kyi 'bras bu yod snyam mi byed pa 'ga' zhig mi rtag pa'i gtam gyis skyo ba bskyed pas sems 'dul bar 'os pa'i rigs la/ gong ma de dag la mtshams zhus kyi rigs yod na de rjes dang*/ med na de mtshams nas 'di skad ces 'dri ste/ slar yang rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyi// phan par gdams pa thos bsam yul bgyis pa'i// gleng ba dam pa'i chos kyi khud pa zhig

/cung zad stob 'dir sgra 'dzin gsos su longs// sngon chad dge ba spyad pas deng gi dus// mi lus dam pa'i chos dang mjal 'di thob// rten 'dis phyi ma'i bde rgyu ma bsgrubs na// thob pa don med 'gyod gzhir mi 'gyur grang*// sngon rabs skyes dgu 'chi ba'i lam song na// phyin chad mi 'chi'i gdeng ldan su la yod// mkha' dbyings sprin gyi 'du god da lta nyid// yod dang med pa'i rnam 'gyur su yid rton// dar bab lang tsho'i me tog gzhon nu yang*// rgas 'khogs sad kyis bcom zhing mi sdug byed// bde ba'i lus ni nad dang sdug bsngal gyis// tsher ma'i tshang du nyal bzhin mi bdes khengs// bsags pa'i dpal 'byor sbrang bu'i sbrang rtsi ltar// rang dbang med pa dgra 'dre'i dbang du 'dzad// bsag dang bsrung bas lus sems ngal ba brgyas// mnar ba snying po 'dug gam mi 'dug gzhig /kha drag dpung chen dag kyang 'chi bdag gis// zin na gcig pur nyam chung 'chi dgos pa// rang gzhan phyogs su brtags na shes sla yang*// rang la 'byung snyam mi byed de re blun// gang tshe stobs 'byor rjes su mi 'brang yang*// las byas rnams ni rang gi rjes 'brang ba// rigs drug skye ba gang du lhung de la// bslu med dus su smin pa rgyal bas gsungs// de phyir rnyed dka'i mi lus sdig pa'i 'dam// bskyur ba de las blun pa 'jig rten su// nya bas rin chen rin thang med rnyed pa// dri ro ma rnyed rgya mtshor bskyur dang mtshungs// dang 'dod yid ches dad pas dkon mchog gsum// skyabs su 'gro 'di lam mchog kun gyi gzhi// 'di mtshan lan re thos kyang 'khor ba dang*// ngan 'gro'i 'jigs las skyob pa thugs rje'i shugs// sdug bsngal 'byung gnas sdig pa'i las spangs nas// bde rgyu dge ba bcu po ci nus sgrubs// lung ma bstan yang dge bar bsgyur shes na// ngan 'gro'i sgo 'gegs pho nya dang po yin// 'khor ba mtha' dag sdug bsngal rang bzhin du// shes nas nags me mched pa'i bya bzhin du// re ltos med par yid 'byung bskyed pa 'di// thar pa bgrod pa'i them skas gnyis pa yin// 'gro kun pha mar shes pa'i drin lan du// sdug bsngal bsal nas bde la dgod bya'i phyir// byams dang snying rje bsgom pa gtsor byed pa// bla med byang chub 'jug sgo gsum pa yin// 'khor 'das chos kun rang sems cho 'phrul snang*// sems snang rmi lam sgyu ma'i rten 'brel la// bdag dang phung po rnam rig rtog pa las// rnam grol lta ba gnas lugs ngang du bskyangs// sems gnyis bskyed pa'i sdom ldan 'phong skyen zhig

/bden gnyis lam gyi mda' gzhu legs sbyar nas// sgrib gnyis dgra sde ming gi mthar byed pa// don gnyis grub bo cog gi bgrod lam yin// lam de'i 'bras bu grub pa sangs rgyas kyi// yon tan bsam mi khyab pas sems can don// 'bad med lhun grub 'khor ba ji srid du// 'byung ba'i dpe zla srid pa gsum na dkon// gang phyir sgo gsum rjes 'brel dge ba'i tshogs// bsags dgu byang chub che de'i rgyur bsngos pas// chu thigs dag byed gter du sim pa bzhin// nam yang 'dzad med 'phel ba'i cho ga bzang*// dal 'byor rnyed dka' bstan pa dam pa'i chos// bsgrubs na 'grub pa'i rten phyir bsngags mod kyi// bza' btung sdig pa'i snod du rung ba la// dam pas bsngags pa min no kwa ye grogs// zhes pa lta bu gang la gang 'tshams kyi gleng bas de dang der phan gdags par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ rnam 'dren kun gyi ye shes rang snang 'jam dpal mkhyen pa'i snang ba che'i// byin rlabs 'od kyi mdzub rtse rnon pos blo gros 'dab stong phye ba'i nang*// mtsho ldan sgeg mos chos rnams thams cad rgyud mangs glu dang bsres nas ni// snyan dngags dam pa'i glu ru len zhes phyogs kyi rna bas mnyen nam snyam// sā la'i nags tshal bsrubs pa'i dri khyer gyis// don mthun dub pa'i snying la bde ster bzhin// sa bdag sras kyi bka' lung gtsug son pas// sna tshogs 'phrin yig snyan dngags 'di byas so// 'on te 'di rigs spros pa mi 'dod ces// smra ba de dag ji snyed shes bya'i yul// thos bsam sbyangs pas dben pa rang nyid dang*// rigs mthun khrod du ngal bsos smra ba skyungs// srid zhi'i yon tan che ldan de dang der// tshangs sras mgrin par rtsen pa'i bsngags brjod kyis// blo ldan dgyes bskyed nus pa de 'dra ni// zong gi dngos brgyas bsgrubs kyang 'grub tu ci// 'gyur khugs rna ba'i dpyid 'di legs bshad glu// ma yin snyan 'jebs ka la piṅka'i dbyangs// 'khor 'das brjod pa legs 'doms 'phrin yig nyid// min no gzugs brgya bkra ba'i me long ngo*// 'char ka'i kun phan mthong bas tshangs pa'i bu// chu 'dzin 'khun sgra thos pas gtsug phud can// srid zhi'i chos kun rgyan gsum lam song ba'i// tshul 'dis dpyod ldan dga' ba cis mi bskyed// dge tshogs 'dzam bu'i snye ma rnam grol gyi// chu gter lhung ba skye 'gro'i gser mig can// gsos gyur mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa'i gser// mngon gyur 'gro la sman 'dogs 'byung gyur cig

/ces srid zhi'i yon tan dang stobs 'byor mchog dman bar pas bsdus pa'i yul la bsngags pa las brtsams pa'i zhu yig stob pa'i dper brjod snyan dngags ngag gi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dbyig 'dzin tha gru yangs par bstan srid zung gi stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur dbang sde dge sa skyong chen po'i lha sras rin po che chos skyong mgon zhes yongs su grags pa gang de'i bka' lung gi yi ge tshar du dngar bas gtsug tu son par brten/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i bande tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i nang gsel rnam gnon zhes bya'i bgrang gzhi'i sgrol byed lha mo khrums kyis nya ba'i dmar phyogs kyi bzang po dang po'i gral tshes dge bar pa sangs nam gru'i 'grub sbyor 'dzom pa'i nyin/ chos grwa chen po lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par grub par bgyis pas 'gro ba thams cad chos dang srid pa'i rnam par gzhag pa la mkhas pa'i rgyur gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
